mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `recharge_activity` ( recharge_amount, enable_gift, gift_amount, recharge_count, `sort`, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.rechargeAmount}, #{item.enableGift}, #{item.giftAmount}, #{item.rechargeCount}, #{item.sort}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime} )

update.foreach: update recharge_activity SET recharge_amount = #{item.rechargeAmount}, enable_gift = #{item.enableGift}, gift_amount = #{item.giftAmount}, recharge_count = #{item.rechargeCount}, `sort` = #{item.sort} WHERE id = #{item.id}
